remarks: In-town colonial charmer with income Potential & single-family flexibility. Nestled on a quiet residential street in the heart of town, this classic two-family colonial offers timeless charm, impressive flexibility, and a truly rare investment opportunity. With its high ceilings, oversized windows, and sun-filled rooms, this home effortlessly blends historic character with everyday functionality. Currently configured as a legal two-family residence, the property includes a versatile studio/home office space above a two-car garage-ideal for a remote work setup, guest suite, or potential in-law/nanny suite. The home's layout allows for easy conversion into a spacious single-family residence, making it perfect for a variety of lifestyle needs, whether you're looking to grow, downsize, or generate rental income. This property has delivered consistent, dependable rental income for 20 years. Live in one unit and rent the other, or lease both for maximum return. The private fenced yard is a serene escape, framed by mature trees and gardens, offering both tranquility and convenience. Located just steps from the new world-class library, shops, restaurants, movie theater, Metro-North train station, and top-rated schools, this property truly delivers the best of in-town living. Whether you're starting out, investing, or retiring, this home presents a unique opportunity to build equity in a highly desirable location. Don't miss your chance to own this one-of-a-kind gem!
